rule: every naming value the raw prints for the number (list rows main, aux; records name, aux, description, other_names; ';' values apart), each with field, kind and site:file:line (curate._wide_names, _kind11). bumper-front/rear: cover ('cover', 'fascia') -> 'bumper cover', or 'bumper cover only' when each of the number's own pages lists a reinforcement as a separate number; 'bumper guard' -> 'bumper guard cover'. tail-lights: 'lens & body' / 'lens & housing' -> 'lens and body unit'. window-regulator: every name field (record name, list main) a regulator with its motor -> 'regulator with motor'. Values of another kind (bumper, reinforcement, lamp assembly, a motor beside a regulator) hold the group; so do a note past 160 and other packaging words already on the note. The phrase goes after the dash of the finished note; nothing else changes.
